scope_change_reason: The catalogue drew an all-size uniform-transfer audit. After orienting on the pending outer-transfer handoff, the live #2293 audit supplied a more decisive named question: whether the edge reading of MAS holds. This changes the audited object to a decoder lower bound; it does not purport to discharge a selected transfer obligation. The independently derived v=9 blow-up family complements the live v<=8 search rather than rerunning it.
bottleneck_link: The three-total decoder pairing-cost problem is a structural route beyond packing. Resolving a false strengthening prevents an unsupported obstruction from being used to reject decoder candidates. This is an algebraic audit, not a new physical supplier.
stop_rule: Stop after one exact admissible counterexample, its analytic family proof, independent rank/acyclicity checks and a public handoff. No exhaustive pairing search or global-minimality claim.
